quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Rehearsing a single word many times before a reunion, and still doubting your own delivery, points to unease about what's ahead.
quests.explanation: Rehearsing one significant word many times, and still doubting yourself, is a specific and grounded apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: She's flying in to meet the baby for the first time since we stopped speaking. I've rehearsed how I'll introduce her as 'Grandma' about a hundred times, and it still catches in my throat every time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone very new handling an emotionally difficult moment better than someone with decades of experience points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone very new handling a hard moment better than an experienced colleague is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The trainee, six weeks into the job, talked a patient's terrified family through a decision so clearly and so gently that the attending physician asked her afterward where she'd trained for that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: People who barely knew you sustaining real, practical care for weeks, without making it uncomfortable, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Near-strangers sustaining real care for weeks, without ever making it feel like charity, is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My neighbors, who I'd exchanged maybe ten words with in three years, organized meals for our family every single night for a month without ever once making it feel like charity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A decision that clearly protects someone while breaking a long-held, once-easy promise to them points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: A decision that protects someone while breaking a long-held promise to them is a genuine, painful conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Moving Dad into care means he's finally safe from the falls. It also means breaking the one promise I made him twenty years ago, back when neither of us thought I'd ever actually have to keep it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone use a trait once treated as a flaw to unite a divided room brings a specific, deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone turn a once-criticized trait into something that unites a divided room is a profound, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter, who spent her school years being told to be quieter, stood up at the town hall and asked the question that got the whole room applauding, including two people who'd been arguing with each other minutes before.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A private ritual reserved for one person quietly folding into an ordinary, general habit points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: A once-private ritual quietly folding into an ordinary, shared habit is a gentle, honest resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I used to save the good news for him specifically, imagining his exact reaction before I even told anyone else. These days the good news just goes straight into the family group chat with everyone else's.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A room full of separate people independently remembering the same small trait points to a deep, collective feeling.
quests.explanation: A room of people independently remembering the very same small trait, without coordinating, is a powerful feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: Every single person at the memorial, one after another, without being asked, brought up the exact same small habit of his, the way he always let the next person go first at the counter. Nobody had planned that. It just kept happening.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A description that doesn't match the basic, checkable facts about a place tends to raise real doubt.
quests.explanation: A glowing description contradicted by basic, checkable facts is a reasonable and well-founded skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The developer's brochure calls the new building 'a vibrant, walkable community,' on a plot with no grocery store, no bus route, and a forty-minute drive to the nearest school.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone breaking an unspoken family pattern that's held for four decades points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone breaking a four-decade family pattern, on their own initiative, is a grounded and moving hope.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody in this family has ever gone back to finish a degree once they'd left it. My mother enrolled again last week, forty years later, in the same course she dropped out of at nineteen.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Facing several major, unrelated life demands at the exact same time, to the point of being unable to move, points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Facing several major, unrelated life demands at once, to the point of being unable to act, is a vivid picture of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Between closing down my father's business, my own diagnosis appointment next week, and a daughter who needs a decision about school by Friday, I sat in the car in a parking lot for twenty minutes this morning without turning the key.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Losing track of an old way of measuring success, entirely on its own, in a genuinely good moment, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: An old way of measuring success simply falling away, unforced, in a good moment, reflects real contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: We are exactly as far along as we are, which is not very far by most measures I used to care about, and watching him fall asleep on my shoulder on this train, I can't locate a single one of those measures in my head right now.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being fully prepared for your own part while remaining genuinely unsure of someone else's points to unease about what's coming.
quests.explanation: Being fully ready for your own part while genuinely unsure of someone else's is a specific, grounded apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: The mediator says both parties will read a statement before any questions. I know exactly what's in mine. I have no idea what's in his, and that's the part I keep circling back to.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone offering ongoing reassurance before you even know to ask for it points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone offering sustained reassurance before you even think to ask is a deep and direct cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The surgeon who operated on my son, unprompted, called every single evening for the first week just to say things were still going as expected, before we'd even thought to ask.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-standing understanding, never doubted, contradicted by an official document points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: A long-standing understanding contradicted by an official document is a real, significant disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole partnership was built on the understanding that both names would be on the practice. The paperwork that arrived this morning only has one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone's lived memory proving more accurate than an official, printed record points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone's lived memory outperforming an official printed record is a genuine, moving cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: My grandmother, ninety-one, corrected the museum guide's date for the photograph on the wall. She was in it. She remembered the year better than the placard did.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Doing the right thing for a stranger while ending a debt of trust to someone who once saved you points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Doing right by a stranger while ending a debt of trust to someone who once helped you is a genuine, painful conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Testifying to what I saw clears an innocent man. It also means the friend who asked me to stay quiet, the one who got me through the worst year of my life, never trusts me again.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group performing something deeply personal from memory, in an unlikely place, purely for one person, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A group performing something deeply personal, from memory, purely for one person, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole choir he used to direct, most of them well into their seventies now, showed up unannounced and sang, from memory, the one piece he always said was his favorite, right there in the hospital corridor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeatedly checking something that was never actually the obstacle points to a restless, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: Repeatedly checking something that was never the actual obstacle is a familiar, human form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing about the transplant list has changed since last week's call. I've still checked my phone's signal bars more times today than I could count, as if that's ever been the problem.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Completing, for someone, the very thing they spent a lifetime doing for everyone except themselves brings a deep, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Completing for someone the thing they spent a lifetime doing for everyone but themselves is a profound, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My father spent thirty years being the man who fixed other people's roofs and never once finished his own. My brother and I put the last tiles up ourselves this weekend, using what he taught us, while he stood below just watching and not saying much of anything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A repeated question about someone long gone, asked as though newly, points to a specific unease about someone you love.
quests.explanation: A loved one repeatedly asking about someone long gone, each time as though for the first time, is a deep and reasonable worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My mother's asked me the same question about her own mother, who's been gone eleven years now, three times this visit, each time as if for the first time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An old, once-assumed life plan fading without protest, no longer spoken of, points to a settled, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: An old, once-assumed plan fading without ongoing protest, and no longer needing to be mourned aloud, is a quiet resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: There was a version of this where we grew old on the same street our whole lives, the way our parents did. That version quietly stopped being the plan a long time ago, and neither of us mourns it out loud anymore.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Avoiding practicing something difficult until the very last possible moment points to unease about the moment ahead.
quests.explanation: Putting off practicing something emotionally difficult until the last possible moment is a grounded apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: The department has asked me to read the names of everyone we lost this year at the memorial. I've had the list for a month. I only let myself practice reading it out loud for the first time last night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A stranger going to real, unnecessary lengths to return something irreplaceable, years later, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A stranger going to real lengths to return something irreplaceable, years after it was lost, is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The stranger who found my late husband's wallet, lost for two years somewhere in this city, tracked down our new address through an old business card inside it and mailed it back with everything, including the photo, still in place.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An old, specific expectation for your life simply losing its grip, unforced, in an ordinary happy moment, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: An old expectation for your life losing its grip naturally, in an ordinary good moment, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: We are not the family I pictured at twenty-five, and some nights, watching the four of us argue cheerfully over a board game neither of the kids will let anyone win, I can't remember why that picture ever mattered so much.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, deliberate shift in someone's careful choice of words points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A small, deliberate shift in someone's careful wording, likely meant to be noticed, is a grounded and earned hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The specialist still won't use the word we're all waiting for. But she used the phrase 'when this is behind you' for the first time today, instead of 'if.' I noticed. I think she meant for me to.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Accepting an outcome that solves a real, urgent need while requiring you to affirm something you know is false points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Solving a real, urgent need at the cost of affirming something you know isn't true is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Taking the settlement means my mother's care is finally paid for without worry. It also means signing something that says the hospital did nothing wrong, when both of us know exactly what happened that night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A younger generation making real, coordinated effort to preserve something in a language not their own, purely to honor someone, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A younger generation making coordinated effort in an unfamiliar language, purely to honor someone, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: Every single one of my father's grandchildren, from three different countries, learned the same four lines of the poem he used to recite, in a language none of them actually speak, just to say it together once, at the end.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Recognizing how far your own understanding has come, without needing anything pointed out anymore, brings a deep, personal feeling.
quests.explanation: Recognizing real, hard-won growth in your own understanding, needing nothing explained anymore, is a genuine and well-earned pride.
quests.textToSpeak: Two hundred levels ago, a sentence like this one would have needed every word spelled out. Reading it now, and simply knowing, quietly, without having to check, is its own kind of finish line.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Recognizing that consistent, quiet effort over a long stretch has led somewhere real points to a warm, reflective feeling.
quests.explanation: Recognizing that sustained, quiet effort over time has led somewhere real is a natural, well-earned gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever got you all the way to this last level, the early mornings, the replays, the levels you almost gave up on, none of it went unnoticed. It added up to exactly this moment.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A finish line that points forward, toward real conversations still to come, rather than backward, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A finish line that points toward real conversations still ahead, rather than simply ending, is a grounded, genuine hope.
quests.textToSpeak: This is the last level, not the last thing you'll ever learn. Whatever conversation you have next, in English, in real life, is the one this was actually building toward all along.
